ToolParser.description: How a tool stage's stdout becomes findings (`parser` of `[[check.tool]]`).

oneOf.description: No parsing: only the exit status matters (`TOOL001`).
zizmor `--format json-v1`: an array of audit findings with byte spans.
actionlint `-format '{{json .}}'`: an array of findings with line and column.
SARIF 2.1.0 on stdout (oxlint, Biome, golangci-lint, Roslyn, the eslint SARIF formatter); ids come from the stage `id_map`.
`cargo ... --message-format=json`: rustc and clippy diagnostics with byte spans; lint names map to `DEAD001`, `NEAT002`, `LOGIC001` or `LINT001`.
stylelint `--formatter json`: an array of files with line and column warnings.
`ruff check --output-format=json`: an array of findings with row and column; rule codes map to `DEAD001`, `ERR001`, `ERR003`, `CONC001`, `TESTQ001`, `LOGIC001` or `LINT001`.
`ty check --output-format gitlab`: a code-quality array with line and column; findings are `LINT001` and mark a file as not type-clean.
`pyright --outputjson`: `generalDiagnostics` with 0-based ranges; error and warning findings are `LINT001` and mark a file as not type-clean.
`tsc --noEmit --strict --pretty false`: `path(line,col): error TSnnnn: message` lines; findings are `LINT001` and mark a file as not type-clean.

`typos --format json`: one JSON object per line, each typo with its line, byte offset and corrections; findings are `SPELL001` (Advisory) and the repository's `typos.toml` allowlist is honoured by typos itself.

`eslint -f json`: an array of files with line and column messages; `jsx-a11y/*` map to `A11Y001`, `react-hooks/*` and `react/*` to `REACT001`, the typescript-eslint promise rules to `CONC001`, `no-explicit-any` and `no-unsafe-*` to `TYPING001`, the rest `LINT001`.
`dotnet build` Roslyn SARIF (CS, CA, IDE, VSTHRD and Microsoft.Unity.Analyzers ids): the SARIF reader with `UNT*` mapped to `UNITY101`, unused-code ids to `DEAD001` and `VSTHRD*` to `CONC001`.
Formatter check-mode output (rustfmt, ruff format, prettier, dotnet format, gofmt): one `FMT001` per unformatted file.
`cargo semver-checks` text report (stderr): one `VERSION001` per broken public item; a crate whose header reports a breaking bump yields none.
`griffe check` one-line breakages (`path:LINE: object: message`): one `VERSION001` each.
`api-extractor run` report-drift output: one `VERSION001` when the committed API report no longer matches the build.

coh.description:
The `[coh]` table: project overrides for COH002 ("decision with effects") and COH003 ("mixed abstraction levels").

The language adapter's effects capability decides by default (a call through `fs`, `os`,
`subprocess` is an effect, `console.log` is not). A configured list adds to it and matches on
the callee's last path segment in any language, so `a.b.send` is `send`: `effect_calls` marks
a name as an effect, `trivial` as never one, and a name in both is trivial. Both default to
empty. A call the capability cannot place leaves the verdict Unresolved until it is listed.
`max_level_spread` is the COH003 threshold: callees further apart than that many layers fire.
